fields.statement: At 9cb629a (attempt 2), go test ./internal/api -run 'TestOpenSessionPane|TestStartCheck|TestStartFix' -count=1 -v: all PASS. TestOpenSessionPane's 'anchor gone splits another pane' case gives a fake rex whose split fails 'block block:b1 not found' and asserts calls size, split -b block:b1, block ls -w window:w1, size of block:b9, split -b block:b9, with no window new, landing in window:w1. New cases: no other pane or window gone (block ls 'not found') opens a new tab; other block ls errors fail. TestStartCheckLatestAnchor asserts paneAnchor uses the run's latest session's pane.
